name: Understanding Context Limits
description: Learn about context windows and how AI agents manage conversation history

steps.content: Let's explore context limits - a fundamental concept in AI agents. Context limits determine how much conversation history I can remember at once.
AI models have a 'context window' - a limit on how much text they can process. Think of it like working memory: I can only hold so many messages before older ones start to fade.
When we reach the context limit, the system must decide what to keep and what to forget. Usually, we keep recent messages and the system prompt, but let older messages drop out.
This transparent agent shows you which messages are in my active context (✅) and which have been truncated (⚠️). You can see exactly what I can 'remember' at any moment.
Why is transparency about context important? Because if I seem to 'forget' something you told me earlier, you can check if that message has been truncated from my context window.
